faq_q1: Where is the money from my sales?
faq_a1: In your own shop bot's balance. The bot was created with your Telegram account and you own it; Telegram only lets the bot's owner withdraw.
faq_a2: Your Stars stay in your own bot, and you withdraw them through Telegram and Fragment without needing us.
faq_a3: No. Everything the buyer pays reaches your bot. Only when you withdraw does Telegram apply its own Stars-to-TON rate.
faq_q4: Why the 1000 Star minimum and 21-day wait?
faq_a4: It's Telegram's own rule for every bot and channel that receives Stars, not UploadFly's. No bot or site selling for Stars can bypass it.
faq_q5: What happens before I reach 1000 Stars?
faq_a5: They keep adding up in your own bot and go nowhere. At 1000, withdraw; or, if you have no TON wallet, use that balance to get Telegram Premium for yourself.

stars_help_btn: No Stars? How to get them
stars_title: What are Stars and where to buy them?
stars_body:
⭐ Stars are Telegram's official in-app currency. When you buy something, the Stars go straight to the seller.
  1. Inside Telegram: Settings → My Stars → Buy (card, Apple Pay or Google Pay).
  2. Resellers: some sites sell Stars for local currency and only need your Telegram username. Compare prices and pick one with real reviews.
⚠️ Never share your Telegram login code or password. A real Stars seller only needs your username.
stars_no_username: You don't have a username yet. In Telegram: Settings → Username. Stars sellers use it to send Stars to you.
stars_after: After buying, come back and tap the pay button again.
cashout_body:
1. Each sale can be withdrawn 21 days later; the usual minimum is 1000 ★.
  2. Withdraw from your shop bot's profile in Telegram → Edit → Balance → Withdraw. Fragment converts it to TON.
  3. The TON goes to a wallet such as Tonkeeper.
  4. Sell TON for your currency on a crypto exchange.
⚠️ Try a small amount first. Fragment may ask you to verify your identity. UploadFly never holds your money; this is between you, Telegram and the exchange.

help_q1: How do I make a free link?
help_a1: Send any file, photo, video, music or text to the main bot and you get a link right away. Anyone who opens the link sees the content protected (no forwarding or saving).
help_a2: Any type of file, up to 2 GB (from the bot chat or forwarded from channels). Automatic previews are made only for files up to 20 MB.
help_q3: How do I turn off a link?
help_a3: In the Mini App, open Files → Free links, tap the link and choose Turn off.
help_q4: How do I create a shop?
help_a4: Tap Create shop on the Mini App home. Telegram makes a bot that you own, and every sale goes straight into it.
help_q5: How do I put a product up for sale?
help_a5: Send the file to your shop bot and pick a price in Stars. The system makes the preview itself, so buyers know what they get.
help_q6: What's a showcase, and how do I make one?
help_a6: Your shop page for your Instagram bio: free, one-time entry or a monthly membership. Tap New showcase on Home and change its look with Style.
help_q7: Why is there a price cap?
help_a7: New sellers have a price cap to protect buyers. It rises with every successful sale.
help_a8: Open the product link or tap Buy and pay with Stars. The content is delivered in that shop's bot chat.
help_q9: I don't have Stars. What now?
help_a9: Tap No Stars? on the buy page or send /stars in the chat. You can buy in Telegram (Settings → My Stars) or from resellers that only need your username. Never share your login code.
help_q10: How do I get a refund?
help_a10: Until you open the content, and within 24 hours of buying, the Refund button under the purchase message returns all your Stars.
help_q11: The content isn't what was described. What now?
help_a11: Tap Report a problem under the content and pick a reason. If you don't hear back, message support from this page.
help_q12: Why can't I save or forward content?
help_a12: To protect creators' work, all content is delivered protected.
help_q13: Why did the content disappear after a few minutes?
help_a13: Sensitive content is deleted after its viewing time. Open the same link again; you don't pay twice.
help_a14: Weapons, drugs, human trafficking, scams and any sexual content involving minors (permanent ban). Adult content only in shop bots and marked sensitive. Full rules: the /terms command.
